messages:
anya: Opening a tiny PR to add a compact tool-calling example + a one-line JSON Schema and short SDK usage hints. Need fast eyeballs for links and wording.

rui: please include an explicit fallback case where the tool returns null and where it errors. reviewers want both.

anya: plan: show prompt -> tool invocation -> tool returns -> assistant final structured output. Keep it under 8 lines.

teo: snippet idea: 
```
User: 'Price for sku 999'
Assistant -> call price_lookup(sku=999)
Tool: {"price_cents":1999, "currency":"USD"}
Assistant final: {"price_display":"$19.99"}
```

kate: add a compact schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"price_cents":{"type":["integer","null"]},"currency":{"type":"string"}},"required":["currency"]} and a one-line note: price_cents may be null on tool failure.

anya: good. also a one-line JS SDK hint showing parse helper vs raw output.

rui: include python minimal example too, and avoid wording that implies runtime enforcement of schema. make it clear parsing/validation is client-side.

docbot: docs-ci: "staging build started for PR #3301"

teo: add an eval case in the PR body (prompt -> expected parsed JSON) so QA can auto-verify.

anya: done. running ./scripts/sanitize-snippets.sh before push.

docbot: docs-ci: "staging build passed (lint + linkcheck) for PR #3301"

kate: quick review: tiny nit on guardrails copy: reword to 'docs recommend validating structured output client-side'

anya: updated and pushed, squashed commits: example, schema, SDK snippets, links.

docbot: "PR merged to main. thread closed."

notes: follow-up ticket will add an extended runbook with error patterns and canonical shim functions.
